english.meaning: to split or fork, as hair ends do or a slit in a skirt
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Thinning damages my hair and makes it prone to split ends. If they don’t thin it, they just keep cutting.
exampleSentences.traditional: 削呢，就削到我啲頭髮好傷。同埋好容易開叉啊。如果佢唔削噉剪剪剪呢。
